title: Gold & Silver Rebound: What Rising Tensions Mean for Your Portfolio

faq.q: Why are gold and silver prices rising now?
faq.a: Gold and silver prices are primarily rising due to increased global geopolitical tensions, particularly in the Middle East, which drives investors towards safe-haven assets. Anticipation of future US interest rate movements also contributes to market uncertainty and demand for precious metals.

faq.q: Is it a good time to invest in gold and silver?
faq.a: Whether it's a good time depends on your individual financial goals, risk tolerance, and existing portfolio. Precious metals can offer diversification and a hedge against inflation and volatility, but their prices can also be volatile in the short term.

faq.q: What are the best ways for an Indian investor to buy gold?
faq.a: Indian investors can buy gold through physical gold (jewellery, coins, bars), Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGBs) for long-term and tax-efficient exposure, or Gold Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) for liquidity and convenience.

faq.q: How do US interest rates affect gold prices?
faq.a: Generally, higher US interest rates make non-yielding assets like gold less attractive compared to interest-bearing alternatives. However, the *uncertainty* around rate hikes or fears of an economic slowdown can still drive investors to gold as a safe haven.

faq.q: Are there tax benefits for investing in gold?
faq.a: Yes, for Indian investors, capital gains from Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGBs) are exempt from tax if held till maturity (8 years). For other forms like Gold ETFs, capital gains are taxed based on the holding period (short-term or long-term).

faq.q: What is digital gold and is it regulated?
faq.a: Digital gold allows investors to buy and sell gold online in small denominations. While convenient, SEBI has expressed concerns regarding regulated entities offering digital gold. Investors should verify the underlying custodian and purity guarantees.
